description: Source code for firmware upgrade hardware abstraction layer wrapper functions, including API calls for getting/setting download interface, download process, reboot, URL management, and firmware update/reset.

methods.name: ssp_FWUPGRADEHAL_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ulong parameter value based on parameter name, calling appropriate HAL API.

methods.name: ssp_FWUPGRADEHAL_Set_Download_Interface
methods.description: Sets the download interface via HAL API.

methods.name: ssp_FWUPGRADEHAL_Download
methods.description: Initiates firmware download via HAL API.

methods.name: ssp_FWUPGRADEHAL_Reboot_Now
methods.description: Triggers reboot after firmware update via HAL API.

methods.name: ssp_FWUPGRADEHAL_Get_Download_Url
methods.description: Retrieves the download URL and filename via HAL API.

methods.name: ssp_FWUPGRADEHAL_Set_Download_Url
methods.description: Sets the download URL and filename via HAL API.

methods.name: ssp_FWUPGRADEHAL_UpdateAndFactoryReset
methods.description: Performs firmware update and factory reset via HAL API.
